comparison.objective: Fit four keyed pieces into a flat square with aligned seams; candidate breaks four installed tangs and recovers them.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-part planar orientation and keyed fitting differ from coaxial mandrel insertion, bimanual hammering, overload regulation, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: All four pieces correctly placed and all seams aligned versus four successful fractures, four contained tangs, and undamaged retained inserts.
comparison.reason: Generic precision placement is shared, but neither the mechanism nor tested outcome overlaps meaningfully.
